626: Meaning, even if he lowered the branches and mixed them the sechach of the sukkah and the sechach of the sukkah was greater than them [i.e., the lowered branches] and it is not noticeable, even so the sukkah is invalid because even though the sukkah's shade is greater than its sunny area, because the shade of the tree is also greater than its sunny area the sechach of the sukkah is of no use.
